notes: Banana Bay Battle: the ships in the background battle are full size.
Banana Bay Battle: bigger ships in two battle lines, with more ropes to swing on.
Ropes are easier to see.
New medal times on Banana Bay Battle.
Banana Bay Battle: a real island at the finish.
The treasure chest is solid now.
The online lobby stacks its two menus when they fit.
Costumes: only the ones you've unlocked are listed.
Banana, Stick and Hook are off for now.
Map pictures now show in a row above your ape.
New map: Banana Bay Battle.
Unlockable costumes: beat a map's Author time to wear its outfit on any map.
Sector Ape: the wreck shortcut now gives a speed boost.
Yeti Peak: fewer low vines.
Sunset Ruins: in the online lobby the temple's mouth shows between the menus and your ape, instead of hiding behind a panel.
Sunset Ruins: flying into the temple, the camera no longer ends up on top of the mouth's stone roof; it stays inside with you.
Sunset Ruins: no more rock poking up through the floor just inside the mouth.
Sunset Ruins: computer players climb back out of the river by its low vines instead of getting stuck on a bank, and the four levels are spread apart again.
Sunset Ruins: a new lobby spot: your ape stands on a ruin in the river with the temple's mouth and the sunset behind it, instead of looking at the ground.
Sunset Ruins: the carved wall panels sit flat on every wall, and their banana glyphs glow where you can see them.
Sunset Ruins: the temple's stone face is solid now; only its open mouth lets you in. Hit the face and you drop into the ravine.
Sunset Ruins: the bridge's boost vines aim a little further into the mouth.
What's New: these patch notes, on the main menu (the version number in the corner opens them too). A New marker shows after an update; tick Show minor patches to see every small fix.
Sunset Ruins: the black block that filled the temple's mouth is gone; from the bridge you can see into the lit corridor.
Sunset Ruins: fall into a spike pit and you're thrown back out within a second or two.
Sunset Ruins: a trapdoor never shuts while an ape is in its pit, so the pit's vines stay down where you can see them.
Sunset Ruins: the river no longer pushes you sideways; its current only carries you downstream, and your keys steer.
Sunset Ruins: the turtles no longer swim into the statues; the statues stand back from the water.
Sunset Ruins: the temple entrance is lit, and carved panels line the walls.
Sunset Ruins: the banana pile at the finish is heaped up differently, not in neat rings.
Sunset Ruins: the sides of the ravine are rocky cliffs.
JOJO MODE and Colourblind Mode now recolour all of Sunset Ruins.
Sunset Ruins has its own picture in the map picker.
New map: Sunset Ruins, a race through jungle temples at sunset.
The first three maps have new names: the Jungle is now Canopy Run, the City is Concrete Jungle and the Ski Slope is Yeti Peak.
Ski Slope: the camera no longer ends up inside the pine trees by the fences.
Dropdowns in the menus and the lobby stay open while you choose, instead of snapping shut.
Random map: each race picks a different map from the last.
Menu buttons and fields answer the first click.
The race setup and the lobby fit on screen, with Start always in view.
No more scrollbar on the menus.
A lineup of every player's ape in the lobby and new lobby spots; taken back out soon after.
Ski Slope: scenery no longer pops in as you race towards it.
Ski Slope: new Blizzard weather.
Ski Slope: item vines carry Christmas stars instead of flowers.
Ski Slope: low vines at every station, easier to reach.
Catch-up vines have their own colour on each map, so they stand out.
Player auras are gone; the apes are bigger instead.
The banana bar fills at 20 bananas, for the same top-speed boost.
Online: everyone sees the host's weather.
Online: players who can't reach each other directly still see each other race.
Online: refresh the page and you rejoin your race.
Sector Ape: falling off only puts you back on a deck behind you, never ahead.
Sector Ape: the flyover behind the title no longer shakes.
Sector Ape has a new picture in the map picker.
New map: Sector Ape, a race through space.
A new map picker.
Ski Slope: in Floor is Lava, a snow leopard hunts you.
Ski Slope: the snow is grippier, so you don't slide as far.
Finish dances: your ape dances when it crosses the line.
The results sit at the side, so you can watch.
Player auras: a glow round every racer in their player colour.
Ape colour palettes: pick your ape's colours.
Online: after a rematch, players start ready.
Online: the host changing a setting no longer un-readies everyone.
The lobby's screech button is hidden for now.
Maps are picked from picture cards.
Your best replays are kept forever.
New map: the Ski Slope.
The version number shows in the bottom right corner.
